name: Exp_VininI_Trend_LRMA
summary: This EA trades based on the VininI_Trend_LRMA custom indicator, which uses a Linear Regression Moving Average with multi-step smoothing. It supports two entry modes: level breakout and direction change (twist), and optionally filters entries using the ChangeOfVolatility indicator in the version with the second handle. Positions are opened and closed systematically with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于VininI_Trend_LRMA自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用线性回归移动平均结合多步平滑算法。支持两种入场模式：水平突破和方向扭转，部分版本还使用ChangeOfVolatility指标作为波动率过滤。系统化地开平仓，配有可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是趋势跟踪，基于VininI_Trend_LRMA指标生成交易信号。该指标通过线性回归移动平均（LRMA）配合多步指数平滑（支持SMA、EMA、JJMA、JurX等多种平滑方法）来识别趋势方向。入场条件有两种模式：BREAKDOWN模式要求指标值突破UpLevel/DnLevel水平线，且前一根K线的指标值未突破该水平；TWIST模式要求指标方向发生扭转，即从下降转为上升或从上升转为下降。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及反向信号触发时平仓。仓位管理方面，通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示占用存款比例。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数执行开平仓操作。在带下划线后缀的版本中，还额外使用ChangeOfVolatility指标过滤信号，要求趋势波动强度超过MaxTrendLevel才允许入场。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following, generating trading signals based on the VininI_Trend_LRMA custom indicator. This indicator identifies trend direction through a Linear Regression Moving Average combined with multi-step exponential smoothing, supporting various smoothing methods including SMA, EMA, JJMA, JurX, and others. Entry conditions operate in two modes: BREAKDOWN mode requires the indicator value to cross above UpLevel or below DnLevel, with the previous bar's value not yet having crossed that level; TWIST mode requires the indicator direction to reverse, changing from declining to rising or vice versa. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, as well as position closure triggered by opposing signals. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent the share of deposit per deal. Money management relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions for executing opens and closes. In the version with the underscore suffix, an additional ChangeOfVolatility indicator filters signals, requiring trend volatility strength to exceed MaxTrendLevel before entry is permitted.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 交易资金占比，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or fixed lot size

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点）

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing buy positions on signal

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: 入场算法模式：突破或扭转
parameters.description_en: Entry algorithm mode: breakout or reversal

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

parameters.name: Length1
parameters.description: 移动平均起始平滑深度

parameters.name: MaxTrendLevel
parameters.description: 执行交易所需的趋势水平（0-100）
parameters.description_en: Trend level required to execute trades (0-100)

pros: 双模式入场策略提供灵活性，既可追踪水平突破也可追踪方向扭转
使用ChangeOfVolatility指标作为波动率过滤器，减少低波动环境下的虚假信号
参数化设计完善，买卖开平仓权限可独立控制，适应不同市场观点
采用多步平滑算法有效降噪，减少价格毛刺导致的误判
有新K线检测机制（CIsNewBar），避免同一K线内重复交易
pros_en: Dual-mode entry strategy provides flexibility, allowing traders to follow either level breakouts or direction twists
Uses ChangeOfVolatility indicator as a volatility filter, reducing false signals in low-volatility environments
Well-parameterized design with independent buy/sell open/close permissions to accommodate different market views
Multi-step smoothing algorithm effectively reduces noise, minimizing false signals from price spikes
New bar detection mechanism (CIsNewBar) prevents redundant trades within the same bar
cons: 止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑ATR等市场波动性动态调整，在不同品种上可能不适配
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同向持仓时重复开仓
依赖两个自定义指标（VininI_Trend_LRMA和ChangeOfVolatility），部署复杂且指标缺失时EA无法运行
缺少点差过滤，在点差较大的品种上可能造成不必要的损失
MM参数为负值时表示固定手数的设计不够直观，容易造成误解
cons_en: Stop loss and take profit use fixed points without ATR-based dynamic adjustment, potentially misfitting different instruments
No position check logic, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
Depends on two custom indicators (VininI_Trend_LRMA and ChangeOfVolatility), making deployment complex and fragile if indicators are missing
No spread filter, which can cause unnecessary losses on instruments with wide spreads
The MM parameter's negative-value-means-fixed-lot design is unintuitive and prone to user misunderstanding
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈功能，使风险管理适应不同市场波动环境
添加持仓检查逻辑，避免同向重复开仓导致过度持仓
增加点差过滤和交易时间过滤，提高入场质量
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to adapt risk management to varying market volatility
Add position check logic to prevent duplicate entries in the same direction, avoiding overexposure
Add spread filter and trading session filter to improve entry quality

risk_points: 没有持仓检查，可能在同方向重复开仓导致过度风险敞口
固定点数止损止盈不适应不同市场波动环境，在高波动市场可能被频繁止损
MM参数的负值设计容易被误用，可能意外使用过大手数
risk_points_en: No position check may lead to duplicate entries in the same direction, causing excessive risk exposure
Fixed-point stop loss/take profit does not adapt to different market volatility, potentially causing frequent stop-outs in volatile markets
The negative-value design of the MM parameter can be misused, potentially leading to unexpectedly large lot sizes
